title: Build entire RPG world concepts in 40 seconds with AI
author: Its_Don
selftext:
I made a tool that creates RPG character sheets in 30 seconds. It did decently, so I added a few features.

Now it can generate realms, locations, factions, characters, items, quests, lore, and a timeline.

Just type details about an existing world or an idea about a new one and it does the rest.

Usable from the homepage. You don't need to sign up. You can ask the World Assistant anything the bottom right window about anything and receive suggestions (though it can't see lore and timeline yet).

It handles grounded or absurd prompts:

* “Make a candy world where everyone is candy”
* “Make an alternative version of World War 2”
* “Make a world with an mc named ‘Skelly’ who’s a skeleton in a fantasy RPG with a mage friend named 'Toffee'"

I'm maybe halfway through development. Planned features include:

* Get manual creation in working condition
* Exportable sheets for each entity
* Filled in detail/info fields for all entities
* Branching ability trees
* World map

Let me know if it breaks. Cheers.
